name: Dark mech, left column, replay
note: Round 15: the left column for watching a replay, worn while one plays. The minimap, the selection and the portrait stand where the game layout has them. The top row is where the replay is over its length in one cell (or the share played) and the Game Menu; under the minimap, View Players, Replay TV and Follow. The players' board takes the groups' place, a row for every player with an eye for that player's vision, over two rows of selection; the replay's own card takes the card's place beside the portrait: the state and the speed, Slower, Play or Pause and Faster, and the speed's ladder of lights. The spine's light is the replay's progress, lit down from the top as it plays. No groups, idle or army button, and no resources at the top: the board has every player's. Built by huds/kits/build-mech.mjs from the parts in mech-parts.mjs.

options.label: Width
options.help: 16:9 keeps the column where a 16:9 screen has it, in from the edge of a wider one, and plates the side past it. On a 16:9 screen or a narrower one the two are the same.

values.label: Full screen
values.help: The HUD runs the width of the screen.
The HUD keeps to the middle of a wider screen, as wide as a 16:9 screen's.

options.label: Replay position
options.help: How far into the replay you are, beside its length: the share of it played, or the time played. The time counts at the speed the game was recorded at, as the game's own timer does.

values.label: Time played
values.help: The time played over the length, as 10:05 / 20:57.

values.label: Per cent
values.help: How much of the replay has played, over the length.

options.label: Stats backing
options.help: What lies behind the players' stats at the side of the view (Shift+F1 in a replay or as an observer): nothing but a shadow under the type, a faint shade, or a darker one.

values.label: None
values.help: The rows alone over the game.

values.label: Faint
values.help: A shade behind the rows, the game showing through.

values.label: Plate
values.help: A darker shade, for a busy map.

options.label: Stats at the side
options.help: Who draws the players' stats at the side: the game's own rows, or this layout's, drawn from the HUD format alone (an each layer, a row a player), which a player could move, restyle or rebuild as they would any layer.

values.label: The game's rows
values.help: The game writes the rows into the layout's stats slot.

values.label: Drawn by the layout
values.help: The layout's own layers draw every row, its eye, the teams and a supply chart.

more.label: The other players, in the stats
